notes.title: 1.1 Update Now Live
notes.content:
A content update for Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop has just dropped – what a time to be alive!

[previewyoutube=GF9okEjZSIw;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside the standard array of bug fixes and accessibility options, you’ll find seven brand-spankin’ new vending machines that will open up some fun and interesting playstyles. The Inflationator, for example, is all about quantity over quality, offering an escalating bonus for every job taken in the run. The Large Loss Nullifier, on the other hand, is all about scoring that one big fuck-up, turning your biggest penalty on the invoice to a positive number. You meant to do that, right? Rigggghhht.

In addition to these are five new Omen upgrades. Some are geared specifically to supporting the use of Vending Machines, others designed to soothe specific pains, like Fatal jobs (go on, have a go at repairing the Reactor, don’t be scared). You’ll also find a new ship type, and a jukebox in the Speakeasy, where you can choose the soundtrack to your work day.

As ever, thanks for all the support, keep the feedback coming, and feel encouraged but not at all pressured to [url=steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FUjreQpcxRw]join us on Discord[/url].

Full change log below:

[h1]Vending machines[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 7 new vending machines:
[*] Build-a-Gumball - Get the Gumball you want, no questions asked!
[*] Inflationator - Adds 3% to the invoice for each completed job.
[*] Large Loss Nullifier - Sets the highest breakage value on the invoice to 1. (Disabled on boss ships)
[*] Small Loss Flipper - Flips the smallest loss on the invoice to positive. (Disabled on boss ships)
[*] Faction Cookies - Increases the chance of customers being the selected faction.
[*] Faction Milk - Adds a 20% bonus to jobs who's customer matches the set faction.
[*] Card Radar - Alerts the owner when a nearby ship contains a trading card.
[/list]

[h1]Omen Upgrades[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new Omen upgrades: 
[*] Vending Variety (3 Tiers) - Increase the number of Vending Machine options by 2, 4, 6.
[*] Nap Time - Sleep through first R.E.N.T. Deliveries will arrive when you wake up.
[*] Workshop Coupon (2 Tiers) - The first/two purchase(s) in Logistics Management is discounted by 50%!
[*] Second Wind - Survive one fatal job! Wake up at the end of the day.
[*] Extra Vending Machine Slot - Unlocks a vending machine slot in the Speakeasy.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Music player. Found in the Speakeasy, you can now play any track from the games soundtrack whilst you work!
[*] Added new ship. The Schlepper.
[*] Reduced the Chunky bonus to 80%.
[*] Colour blind friendly mode 
[*] Level pull LED has R/G letter indicating is it's Red or Green.
[*] Donut orders no longer affected by lighting. This should help with contrast between colour palette.
[*] Gumballs use an alternate colour palette (Color-Blind Safe by IBM).
[*] Added option to disable skipping dialogue when dialogue has yes/no options.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed canister preview appearing in Honk Pancake Picker.
[*] Fixed missing invoice item name for missing motors in AI module.
[*] Fixed issue with Short Sighted Achievement not being granted.
[*] Fixed issue with using tool controls & touch controls on Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed cursor lag on Steam Deck when using USB mouse.
[*] Fixed Towing feeing being listed as 125 when it's actually 250.
[*] Fixed issue with VR crash event occasionally adding towing fees to subsequent jobs that day.
[/list]

A massive thanks to all of you for your support and continued feedback: we're constantly reading and discussing what you guys have to say, and it's proved invaluable in shaping the updates over the past few days and the updates to come. 

Of particular importance for many of you will be the changes we've made to the Tomfoolery and Reactor modules; coming across these in your run should now be a far less brutal (and potentially fatal) experience. And to the OGs who endured the launch version of the Reactor, wear your scars with pride.

notes.title: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop is released!
notes.content:
Hey there! Beard Envy here. 

Well, today’s the day. Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop has now been released and is available to exchange for a reasonable sum of currency, as is customary.  

It’s been a wild few years getting here and the fact that it’s out there in people’s hands now doesn’t feel quite real. In some ways, it’s felt like a private little fever dream, so the fact that you folks are sharing in it now is wonderful and strange and viscerally terrifying.

Sincerely, we hope you like it. We’ve poured our hearts into this project, so more than anything we’d love to know that we brought you folks a neat experience. It’s all we’ve ever wanted for it. So, if you picked it up, just know that we’re grateful beyond words. A looming, cosmic kind of grateful. The kind that might send you mad if you made eye contact with it for too long.  

Hmm.

Anyhow.

I want to give a heartfelt shoutout to all the peeps who played the demo and gave us feedback and suggestions. It was completely invaluable in shaping the game as it stands and we couldn’t have done it without you. If you did play the demo, we hope that you feel we listened and that you enjoy all of the changes we made at your behest. You helped us a ton, and we think you’re pretty cool for that.

For anyone interested, we’ll be doing a modest release stream this Saturday (7th) at 7pm GMT. You should come hang out with us and we can talk shop about the game. Maybe lowball us a few questions and tell us about your experience? Yeah. Yeah, that sounds nice. 

Also, please consider dropping in on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849790/Uncle_Chops_Rocket_Shop/?utm_source=socials&utm_medium=twitter&utm_campaign=socialslink&utm_id=social-link]our Discord[/url]. You can leave those burning questions in advance, assimilate into the community or just post goofy things for us to muse over. The possibilities are limited and predictable.

Alright, nerds. Signing off then. Catch you at the weekend and have a blast fixing spaceships (or other valid stuff) in the little world we built.

Much love,

Aaron, Ben & Jo
xoxo

Noice.

notes.title: Next Fest demo available now!
notes.content:
Grab your toolbox and technical manual, it’s time to get your paws dirty – the Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop demo is here!

Experience your first shift as our fox-headed mechanic Wilbur, fixing spaceships for ungrateful customers and an even more ungrateful corporate overlord. How many runs will it take you to make R.E.N.T.?

[u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849790/Uncle_Chops_Rocket_Shop/]Join the devs for their livestream[/url][/b][/u] at 10pm BST on June 10th, where they’ll be talking about the game while trying to beat the current demo record for most money earned in a single R.E.N.T. cycle. Think you can beat the record? [u][b][url=https://discord.gg/hM8GxaA7Xx]Head over to the Discord to take part.[/url][/b][/u]

Want to design a unique customer for the game? Me too, but I was told my ideas are too deranged – which is saying a lot for a game like Rocket Shop. Apparently they’d rather trust a rando like you; [u][b][url=https://gleam.io/RLO9Z/ucrs-next-fest]click here to learn more[/url][/b][/u] (we’re also giving away T-shirts and Steam keys to a lucky few).

See you there!

notes.title: Come join the developer livestream!
notes.content:
This is your chance to glean some insights into the minds behind Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop! 

Watch the developers at 10pm BST/2pm PT try to beat the current record for number of coins earned in a single R.E.N.T. cycle, while explaining the game's design and answering all your questions. 

Think you can beat the record? Such arrogance. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849790/Uncle_Chops_Rocket_Shop/]Download the demo here[/url] and be prepared to provide proof over in [url=https://discord.gg/5Mn3EStW6q]our Discord[/url].

notes.title: Next Fest demo coming June 10th – fix spaceships or die tryin’!
notes.content:
Devotees, get ready to roll up your sleeves and fix some ships for our porcine corporate overlord – Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop will be participating in Steam Next Fest from June 10th! 

For new players, this will be your chance to learn what a roguelite fix’em’up is first-hand, while for our previous OG playtesters, you’ll see a whole host of changes – not least of which, a brand new untimed game mode offering a different kind of challenge – and fresh, juicy gameplay content. 

Steam Next Fest, June 10th, put it in your calendar! Alternatively, [url=https://discord.gg/8Ng6XAFKV4]join us in Discord,[/url] where you’ll be in no danger of forgetting because we won’t shut up about it..

notes.title: This roguelike "fix 'em up" might be the best puzzle game of 2024
notes.content:
The rent is due, and my landlord is going to kill me. No, this isn't a cry for help - it's actually the failure state for Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop, a "roguelite fix 'em up" that's quite unlike anything I've played before.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop opens for business this November!
notes.content:
What’s that? When is this game ACTUALLY coming out? I know, you’ve waited long enough but less of the sass alright? Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop will be officially open for business in November 2024!

We will be waiting for you on your first day but brace yourself for some dark humour, challenging modules and well… it’s a roguelite so… death.

But I promise you, it’s really fun! Check out our new trailer to find out for yourself…

notes.title: Your shift at Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop awaits! 🔧

Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop is now open for international playtesting! Whether you speak Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Russian, or Italian, we want YOU to be a part of our playtest. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the upcoming demo and the final version of the game.

notes.title: Playtest Build Update 4
notes.content:
You know the drill – you tell us what's wrong, we make it right, all is forgiven.

To everyone with access to the playtest who hasn't yet got involved, now's the perfect time; we'll be running the playtest until at least the end of the year, while [url=steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FUjreQpcxRw]chillin' at the Discord fireside[/url].

If you're in the US, UK, Canada or Australia and haven't yet signed up, it's not too late – head over to the store page and request access, and we'll grant you entry shortly after.

[/list]

[list]

[/list]
[h1]Manual[/h1]
[list]

[/list]
[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Build Update
notes.content:
Thanks to all those who have submitted feedback so far, we’re incredibly grateful. 

We’ve just pushed a patch for the playtest build. Here’s what’s changed:

[h1]General Changes
[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed manual being available early to the player in the tutorial module where they first receive it.
[*] Fixed being able to get a mystery job in tutorial.
[*] Fixed tutorial soft lock after letting the day timer run out.
[*] Fixed weird objective text wrapping.
[*] Tweaked some Droose tutorial dialogue.
[*] Slightly reduced intensity of landing ship camera shakes.
[*] Crashed ship will only ever spawn with Oil module on day 2.
[*] Security mini-boss – will now spawn with Oil and Fuel modules + one random one.
[*] Security mini-boss – reduced total breakage allowance on job (i.e. less can go wrong).
[*] Fixed collision on arrival capsule launch controls.
[/list]

[h1]Controls and Interface
[/h1][list]
[*] Added 'a' & 'd' keybinds to tool mode toggling
[*] Adjusted auto-round value on screws – this should result in less unwanted snapping back!
[*] Added key prompt for Toilet module hose trajectory.
[*] Tweaked dialogue control prompts.
[*] Now auto-hides irrelevant control prompts when in conversation.
[*] Fixed checklist being stuck on screen for a short time after handing in job.
[*] Fixed issue with tutorial objectives not correctly removing.
[/list]

[h1]Module Changes
[/h1][list]
[*] Star Map module – fixed manual icon not being attached to door.
[*] Star Map module – fixed issue resulting in false reporting of doors being left unsecured.
[*] Tomfoolery module – now only appears from day 2 onwards.
[*] Tomfoolery module – now correctly loads error level when cartridge is not correctly encoded.
[*] VR module – now only appears from day 2 onwards.
[*] Oil module – tweaked acceptable max oil level.
[*] Oil module – tweaked related manual pages.
[*] Security module – tweaked related manual pages.
[*] Security module – increased the max timer.
[*] Security module – increased the top-up timer increment.
[/list]
